ios.desc:
Pressbook is an on-device photo album, collage, and carousel maker for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It turns your camera roll into magazine-style albums and photo books. Your photos are never uploaded to us, you don't need an account, and it's free to start.

Share your work.
One Share panel for albums, collages, and carousels — share a live memory, send a file, save images, export a PDF, or make a Reel. Invite with a one-person iCloud link for comments and reactions, or open a public link for reactions only. Guests open in Pressbook on their own device through your iCloud. Sharing is free for everyone.

Circles, shared both ways.
A private place for the people you invite, one at a time. Everyone in a circle shares albums, collages, and carousels, reacts to pages as they read, and comments. Updates keep every version, and a widget shows the newest from the circle you choose. It all goes through your iCloud.

Reels for Stories and social.
Turn a collage into a layer build-up reel, or a carousel into a continuous swipe or build reel — ready for stories and short-video apps.

Reactions and comments.
On a private shared memory, everyone can react and leave a short note. On multi-page albums, reactions sit on each page. Pick up to two people to sign off a page or ask for a change. Owners see Changes and can reply when they mark a note addressed.

Memory Capsule.
Seal a share until a birthday, anniversary, or any day you choose. Guests see the same countdown. On the day it opens for everyone together. You can still edit as the owner and push updates anytime.

What you can make

Photo albums and photo books.
Multi-page albums that read like a printed magazine. Auto layout or pick each design. Flip with a page curl. Cover titles sit in Signature. On iPad, an opening sits across the spine. On iPhone Duo, the spine lands on the fold. Export a 600 DPI PDF for print.

Video carousels.
Two to ten panels you swipe through, with photos and video across the cuts. Export as sliced images, one video, or a carousel Reel.

Collages.
One composition from several photos, sized for a feed or story. Video clips work too. Export a still or a build-up Reel.

How it works
Pressbook reads your photos on your phone and builds the story — time, place, best burst frame, faces kept, people balanced. A fullness slider sets how full each page feels.

Your photos stay private.
Made on your phone. No sign-up. Nothing uploaded to us for making the work. Shared copies move through your iCloud to peo
